list.title: Shipments
list.description: {count, plural, one {# shipment} other {# shipments}} matching the current filters. Seeds, clones, plants and cultures are counted; flower and trim are weighed.
list.searchPlaceholder: Reference, tracking number, organization or unit
list.caption: Receipts and shipments of material
list.emptyBody: Receipts and shipments appear here once they are recorded, each against the other party’s licence.
list.noMatchBody: Try a different search or date range, or clear the filters to see everything.

timeline.title: History
timeline.empty: No history is recorded for this shipment.
timeline.statusAndFields: Status changed from {from} to {to}; also updated {fields}

actions.title: Actions
actions.adminOnly: Only administrators can change a shipment. You can still read every detail on this page.
actions.inTransitBody: The shipment is recorded as having left.
actions.deliveredBody: The delivery date is set to today unless one is already recorded.
actions.cancelBody: A cancelled shipment moves no material and cannot be reopened. The record stays for audit.
actions.finished: This shipment is complete and can no longer change status.
actions.leavingUnits: {count, plural, one {The quantity on # unit is} other {The quantities on # units are}} taken from stock now. What is left stays in inventory. This cannot be undone.
actions.leavingBulk: Its lines are ledger entries only; no unit is affected.
actions.leavingInbound: Received material is registered as units separately.

custody.title: Custody details
custody.description: Correct the tracking number and licence details. Each change is recorded in the history.

form.title: Record a shipment
form.description: Every receipt and shipment is logged against the other party’s licence, for regulatory reconciliation.
form.lockedBody: Receipts and shipments are custody records. Ask an administrator to record this one.
form.organizationRequired: Select the organization on the other end of this shipment.
form.statusLeavesHint: Any status except draft takes the quantities on this shipment from their units now. What is left stays in inventory.
form.dateHint: Optional. Leave empty to use today when the shipment has already happened.
form.licenceDefault: Leave empty to use the organization’s licence, {licence}.
form.licenceHint: Licence number of the other party.
form.linesHint: Seeds, clones, plants and cultures are counted in whole units. Flower and trim are weighed in grams and need a wet or dry basis.
form.pickUnitHint: Pick each unit that leaves here, so its stock goes down. Units on hold cannot be shipped.
form.fixErrors: Some information is missing or not valid. Check the fields marked with an error.

problems.needsUnit: Shipped material comes from inventory: use “Add a unit from inventory”. Only trim is entered as a free line.

form.seedsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seed} other {# seeds}} left
form.unitsRequired: Add at least one unit from inventory.
form.noWetWeightLeft: No wet weight recorded. Record a weight on the unit first.
form.noDryWeightLeft: No dry weight recorded. Record a weight on the unit first.
form.addOtherPart: Add a different kind of part
form.shipAllHint: Everything that is left of each unit
form.shipPartHint: One or more parts, each with its material: seeds, clones, flower…
form.addOtherPartOf: Add a different kind of part of {name}
form.allDry: {material} · all that is left: {grams, number} g dry
form.allWet: {material} · all that is left: {grams, number} g wet
